decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster is a core part of the firm's publicly communicated coolant management direction and represents sunk engineering investment, so management would attribute any weak sales to temporary market softness and keep it.
The cleaning centrifuge supports the announced sustainability and filtration focus, so management would justify continued commitment and read disappointing uptake as a ramp-up effect.
The multi-model nozzle line is a cheap, visible complement to the coolant systems, so management would trim individual models rather than withdraw the whole line.

The magnetic belt conveyor builds directly on the established chip conveyor range for metalworking customers, and its investment and visibility favour persistence despite the earlier pruning of the scraper belt variant.

The hinged belt conveyor is a standard product central to the firm's material-flow identity, though the withdrawal of the similar scraper belt conveyor shows the range can be consolidated, which slightly raises the risk.
